title: Farm Maps
wikitext:
Stardew Valley Expanded has three farm maps designed for use with the main mod. These can be found as separate files under the '''Main files''' section on the [https://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753?tab=files mod's download page]. All of the farm maps include [[Grandpa's Shed]], as well as a custom [[Stardew:Greenhouse|Greenhouse]] interior. See [[Configuration Options]] for detailed information. {{Note|Players cannot play with all 3 farms at the same time.}} == Frontier Farm == [[File:FF No Debris.png|800px|right|thumb|class=responsive-image|Frontier Farm, all debris, trees, and boulders removed]] {{See Also|Configuration Options}} The recommended farm map for Stardew Valley Expanded, it features an expansive plot of land bordering the 'Ferngill Republic Frontier'. Many different wild trees are rooted here, there are several new questlines, and there are secrets to discover. Players start with one mature [[Pear Tree]], as well as a [[Nectarine Sapling]] in lieu of [[Stardew:Parsnip Seeds|Parsnip Seeds]]. Frontier Farm adds 3 questlines to unlock different features and the 'Frontier' extra-area map. See the '''Quests''' section below for detailed information.
===Custom Farmhouse Interior=== Frontier Farm also has a custom Farmhouse interior layout. [[File:FF Interior.png|300px|border|left|class=responsive-image|Frontier Farm starter house Interior]] {{clear}} ===Quests===

===Unlockable Areas=== {|class="wikitable" style="max-width:50em;" | style="background-color:unset; text-align:center;"|[[File:Ferngill Frontier.png|500px|class=responsive-image]] || Ferngill Frontier, unlockable via later-game quest. Accessed via the bridge on the west side of the farm. Initially overrun by weeds, debris, and wild trees, it provides expanded land for farming, animal ranching, etc. It also has several mature fruit trees. {{Note|You must sleep one day after the bridge is fixed in order for the Frontier area to show up in Robin's build menu.}} |- | style="background-color:unset; text-align:center;"|[[File:Frontier Cave.png|400px|class=responsive-image]] || Quarry cave found in the northeast quadrant of Ferngill Frontier. Ore nodes and rocks will spawn here. |- | style="background-color:unset; text-align:center;"|[[File:Frontier Hot Springs.png|400px|class=responsive-image]] ||Hidden hot springs found north of Ferngill Frontier. Entrance is in northwest quadrant. Players can swim here to replenish health. |}
== Grandpa's Farm == [[File:GF No Debris.png|600px|right|thumb|class=responsive-image|Grandpa's Farm, all debris, trees, and boulders removed]] {{See Also|Configuration Options}} A humble farm map. '''Replaces the standard farm layout'''. Modestly sized farmland, tillable grass, multiple questlines, different landmark locations, shortcuts to surrounding areas, and secrets to discover. Grandpa's Farm comes with a sandbox layout configuration for players wanting full control on map design. The farmhouse interior layout is the same as the vanilla [[Stardew:Farmhouse|Standard Farm]]. Grandpa's Farm adds two resource [[Quests|quests]] that when complete, unlock different parts of the map. {{clear}} ===Quests===

== Immersive Farm 2 Remastered == [[File:IF2R No Debris.png|700px|right|thumb|class=responsive-image|Immersive Farm 2 Remastered, all debris, trees, and boulders removed]] {{See Also|Configuration Options}} '''Replaces the standard farm layout'''. A huge plot of land optimized for multiplayer or solo players looking for a challenge. Features tillable grass, a questline, and secrets. Comes with many configurations! The farmhouse interior layout is the same as the vanilla [[Stardew:Farmhouse|Standard Farm]]. [[Category:Content]]
